info.description: This pricing course provides a comprehensive examination and discussion of relevant theories, models, concepts, mechanisms as well as the role of technological innovation. The theoretical framework will be enhanced with practical applications, examples and case studies in all relevant areas. The course will integrate strategic, economic, marketing, psychological, legal and ethical principles and considerations and enable the student to maximize profitability through application of relevant techniques.
